card.name: Inside drug names in interaction text
card.fires_on: Partway through a long drug or drug-class name, such as phen|obarbital, led|ipasvir, cortic|oster|oid, in drug interaction passages. Also on a few joining words or commas in lists of co-administered drugs.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Early or middle pieces of long drug or class names, before the name is complete.

modes.label: Joining words in interaction lists
modes.description: Words or commas that link co-administered drugs in interaction sentences.
